verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Canny's feedback collection, MCP integration, and changelog announcements, but never describes an automatic notification sent to individual customers when the status of their specific feature request changes. Changelog (canny-docs-8) is a broad announcement mechanism, not a per-voter automated status-change alert. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic status-change email/notification triggers to voters, any workflow/automation-rule feature tying status transitions to customer notifications.
